descriptionFull: The long-eared owl ( Asio otus ), also known as the northern long-eared owl , is a species of owl which breeds in Europe, Asia, and North America. This species is a part of the larger grouping of owls known as typical owls, family Strigidae, which contains most species of owl. The other grouping of owls are the barn owls, family Tytonidae.
